selection_note: Initial five-stock research basket. Selected from the official NIFTY 50 constituent weight snapshot dated 2026-02-27, cross-checked for stock-option contract discovery/activity. This is not claimed to be a synchronized top-five average-option-volume ranking; comparable common-window liquidity audit is mandatory before strategy testing.

stocks.selection_rationale: Highest-weight constituent in the cited official snapshot; publicly discoverable listed stock-option calls and puts.
Second-highest weight in the cited official snapshot; NSE stock-options page shows multiple listed calls and puts.
Third-highest weight in the cited official snapshot; NSE stock-derivatives page exposes stock-option calls/puts and contract information.
Sixth by weight in the cited official snapshot; NSE page shows listed stock-option calls and puts with recent expiry contract activity.
Seventh by weight in the cited official snapshot; public stock-options quote reports active listed calls and puts.

phase_103_1_required_common_window_metri: eligible underlying sessions and exact option-contract sessions
option premium turnover and contract volume by expiry/strike/right
open interest and change in open interest (preserving missing versus true zero)
bid-ask spread, spread as a fraction of mid-price and quote depth where licensed
active-strike and expiry coverage, stale/crossed quote diagnostics
date-effective contract multiplier/lot size, expiry calendar and corporate actions
not_started: fixed-contract strike-surface continuity audit across seven relative offsets

data_source_protocol.primary_source: DhanHQ Data API expired stock-options rolling history
data_source_protocol.token_handling: Access token is injected at runtime from GitHub Actions secrets; never log or commit it.
known_constraints: Relative strike path can change actual strike through time
No historical bid/ask/depth documented by this endpoint
Raw retention/republication rights not yet verified
Raw payloads are not committed or uploaded; derived aggregate audit only
data_source_protocol.next_gate: Seven-offset fixed-strike continuity on a common one-day sample; no P&L before exact expiry identity, source rights and execution-cost gates pass.
data_source_protocol.note: Initial expiryCode=0 was rejected by the API with DH-905 'expiryCode is required' for all 10 probes, despite the annexure describing 0 as current/near expiry. Retry uses expiryCode=1, the sample request value and documented Next Expiry, and will be audited separately.

provider_end_date_semantics.observed_behavior: Dhan rolling-options endpoint included toDate rows in a request from 2026-08-03 to 2026-08-04 despite current documentation describing toDate as non-inclusive.
provider_end_date_semantics.adapter: Preserve study target [from_date,to_date_exclusive), call Dhan with fromDate=from_date and toDate=(to_date_exclusive - 1 calendar day).
provider_end_date_semantics.validation: Check every returned timestamp in Asia/Kolkata against the original half-open target window; any out-of-window row blocks the sample.

strike_surface_audit.next_gate: Audit all remaining stock/side groups and report fixed-strike coverage using no imputation.
